seed_selection: valid high alpha>.9, depth .35..12, ROI, stride3, low alpha<.7 OR relative depth error>.08 OR RGB error>.08; unique voxel; fixed random subsample; new seeds exclude shared old-seed voxels
geometry_update: Same initial low model plus common old-input RGB-D seeds in every group; add group-specific new-input seeds. Optimize all Gaussian parameters; no later split/prune.
loss: RGB L1 + .2 relative depth L1 (clipped1) + .05 alpha deficit, on valid GT pixels for depth and alpha; RGB full image
heldout_scope: Original 32 held-out frames, excluded from original low training and full-input reliability calibration; remove near augmentation views (distance<.4 and rotation<20deg), same heldout set for all groups
new_observation_source: high PLY pseudo-GT RGB-D at recorded poses; oracle RGB-D augmentation, not RGB-only/video enhancement
old_observation_source: existing 128 training camera poses; high PLY re-render at320 for consistent RGB/expected-depth targets. These poses already had RGB-D reconstruction inputs.
scores: Use previously frozen full-input RGBDN B; no B-guided frame selection or changes
interpretation: Validate groups of81 views, not individual marginal frame utility. Same compute, two seeds, one scene; relative to both untouched low and replay-only. No claim of full 2D GauSS-MI replication or real-world GT.
